title: eruca sativa var. aurea
intro: Eruca sativa var. aurea, commonly known as Golden Rocket Cress, is a variety of the Eruca sativa plant, a type of leafy green vegetable. This plant is known for its health benefits, including its ability to reduce inflammation, improve digestion, and support cardiovascular health. The therapeutic actions of Golden Rocket Cress include its antioxidant, anti-inflammatory, and antimicrobial properties, which make it a valuable addition to herbal remedies for various health issues. The bioactive constituents of Eruca sativa var. aurea include isothiocyanates, flavonoids, and phenolic acids, which contribute to its medicinal properties.
